name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three static HTTPS virtual hosts, including HTTP redirects and development self-signed certificates. It also applies host hardening through Fail2ban, UFW, sysctl, and SSH restrictions.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and a password-protected Redis instance, including Redis log storage and generated configuration compatibility adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from Git with a Python virtual environment and systemd-managed Uvicorn service. It also provisions a local PostgreSQL database, user, and application environment file.
